svg.title: Projection neuron responses against receptor input for 4-methylcyclohexanol and 3-octanol: the model alone and in the whole odor against Olsen et al.'s transform, and the summed responses by input strength
svg.text: The projection neurons' weak end is half of flies', and 4-methylcyclohexanol lives there
Lines: Olsen et al.'s transform for flies (solid) and with the odor's normalization (dashed). Rings: the model's glomeruli driven alone, at about half the solid line;
red: in the whole odor, where the model divides about as flies do until weak glomeruli fall below threshold. Right: summed by input strength.
